2585aba510.q: Why did the host of Be a PROFITABLE Badass Small Business Owner Podcast put the show on pause after 740 episodes?
2585aba510.a: The host realized after 10 years that something had to give because of multiple personal and professional demands. Family responsibilities increased significantly, including caring for parents before they passed and now taking in a mother-in-law with dementia, while simultaneously running two businesses working 60-80 hours a week. The host decided to pause the podcast to free up time for creating training videos and tools to help small business owners understand P&Ls and financial reports at a deeper level.
2585aba510.rq: To be a small business owner, you really are a badass just to get up and go do it with no guarantees, no promise of a paycheck.

9fec7eece4.q: What are the main reasons small business owners failed after the 2008 financial crisis according to the Be a PROFITABLE Badass Small Business Owner host?
9fec7eece4.a: Small business owners failed primarily because they were not profitable before the crash and had no contingency plan. Those who did not understand their business numbers made poor decisions and threw away money without knowing if they would get a return. Many exhibited victim mentality, blaming the economy instead of pivoting their business model. Owners who survived were those with money in the bank, little to no debt, who pivoted their services when customer demographics changed, and who paid attention to profitability rather than just top-line sales.

8faa67ad93.q: What is the three-bucket sales growth model explained by the Be a PROFITABLE Badass Small Business Owner host?
8faa67ad93.a: According to the host, sales growth comes from three buckets: you can increase your new customers, you can get your existing customers to come back more often, or you can increase your average ticket price per transaction. This concept has remained the same for 40 years and is universal across all businesses regardless of industry.

6244fe445c.q: What business experience did the host of the Be a PROFITABLE Badass Small Business Owner Podcast have before starting the podcast?
6244fe445c.a: The host spent 22 years at Home Depot working up to managing million-dollar stores and million-dollar districts before leaving corporate America in 2008.
